_comment: signal_modulation/05_test_design (updated 2026-09-09): AM reservoir on the EMISSION+PUMP model. rate_32 REMOVED — the recharge is done by the PUMP (1->4->3), NOT the spontaneous upper-state decay. The real 230 us lifetime (=rate_32) is simply omitted (it is 6.9e10 t.u., not FDTD-simulable); the inversion's recovery / fading-memory timescale is set instead by the PUMP rate, which is fast and FDTD-feasible. Pump amplitude raised 50->100 so the inversion reaches its (input-dependent) STATIONARY state quickly (design01: N3 settles by ~1200 t.u. at pump 100 vs ~2900 at pump 10) — fast enough to track the drive within the run. Mechanism: no signal -> pump drives N3 up (toward full); signal on -> stimulated 3->2 (emission) depletes it; the balance is the reservoir state. Drive is source_type 'symbols' (piecewise-constant random amplitudes, symbol_length 2000 t.u.) for the fading-memory / AM demo. Backend MUST be meep for symbols (CustomSource); gpumeep has no rate_32 anyway but that no longer matters since rate_32 is gone. UNITS a=1um, 1 t.u.=3.33 fs. PILOT: watch pop_monitor for the settling time and snap_point for the output tracking the symbols; if stationary is not reached fast enough, raise the pump further (it is the speed knob).

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG gain, emission (stimulated 3->2, the signal coupling) + pump only; rate_32 (spontaneous 3->2 decay) REMOVED. Recharge is pump-driven, so the pump amplitude sets how fast the stationary inversion is reached. rate_43/rate_21 stay the fast feeder/drain.

source_1._comment: reservoir input drive: piecewise-constant random amplitudes u(n) ~ U(amp_range), one per symbol_length, on the 1.064 um carrier. seed 0 => analysis regenerates the exact sequence (symbols_source.symbol_sequence) to build regression targets. amp_range spans ~linear to ~saturating around design01's amp 1.0 - tune after the pilot.

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump from above (y-normal sheet on the crystal top edge), Ez orthogonal to the Ey signal. With rate_32 finite the pump now sets a STEADY inversion (pump-in vs rate_32-out balance) instead of just pre-loading it; amp 50 from design01, tune if the steady N3 sits too low/high.

snap_point._comment: output y-LINE time record (1Dsnap = line in y). The multi-strip output is y-dependent, so a single point misses the transverse profile; this records the whole output-guide y-line vs time. dt 20 (coarse on purpose) keeps storage modest for long/many runs — tune down toward the 1.064 carrier period (~1.06 t.u.) if you need the field phase rather than the envelope.

pop_monitor._comment: inversion vs time - THE key plot for this toy: N3 should be seen bleaching on each strong symbol and RECHARGING between them (tau_32 = 5000 t.u.), i.e. actually recovering within the run, which no prior design could show.
